versions.localizedDescription:
### 🚀 Remmich 0.6.0

**Your read-only Immich library, native on iPhone and iPad.**

Albums now join Photos and Videos as a real part of your Immich library in Remmich. Browse your albums, keep their index available offline and move between layouts and timelines without losing your place.

### 🎯 What this release focuses on

Version 0.6.0 focuses on Albums: finding an album, opening its timeline and returning to where you were. Interactive pinch, animated sorting and consistent page transitions bring Albums into the native viewing experience introduced in 0.5.0.

### 🧭 Current status

This is an early release. Photos, Videos, Albums, account settings and the implemented viewer/export features use your real Immich account. Search and Library collections still show demo data. Uploading, editing albums and modifying the Immich server library remain outside Remmich's read-only scope.

### ✨ Highlights

#### 🗂️ Albums & navigation

- 🗂️ **Real Albums:** Browse owned and shared albums with search, Cards and List, plus six sorting options with ascending/descending direction.
- ↔️ **All & Shared:** Switch with the same sliding animation as the main pages while search and tab controls stay in place. Both views start from the bottom, with consistent spacing above the navigation bar—even below wrapped album titles.
- 🤏 **Interactive layouts:** Pinch between Cards and List around the album under your fingers. Reverse the gesture or interrupt settling without opening the album on release.
- ✨ **Cleaner rearranging:** Sorting keeps your view in place while albums move. Card/List transitions animate long titles between their wrapping layouts, and sorting large album collections uses less memory.
- 🖼️ **Album timelines:** Open from the cover with a zoom transition and return to the album's saved browsing position, using the shared timeline and viewer.
- 🧭 **More consistent navigation:** Long-press Back retains your asset context. Tab retaps scroll Photos, Videos and the current album timeline to their latest items with interruptible spring motion. Page swipes no longer accidentally open albums, and tab switches keep animating with the Library profile open.

#### 💾 Offline browsing & account storage

- 💾 **Album Index:** Automatically save album lists, memberships and date groups for offline metadata browsing. Unchanged album contents are reused by revision.
- 📊 **Clearer progress:** Separate Timeline/Album Index controls show percentages, item counts, elapsed/estimated time and storage statistics. Swipe between sections or use the picker.
- 👆 **Easier Index controls:** Scroll from the status area in both Index sections. Sync/Pause/Resume and **Rebuild index** sit directly below the statistics, with cleaner spacing in Album Index.
- 🔐 **Account separation:** Per-account catalog/cache databases improve storage accounting and local-data deletion safeguards. Timeline and Albums reuse asset records and cached media, with independent index rebuilds.

#### ✨ Viewing & connections

- 🖼️ **Info spacing:** The photo now resizes together with the Info panel, removing the extra gap seen on first opening.
- 🌐 **Custom endpoints:** User-configured HTTP Immich and Photon endpoints are now permitted alongside HTTPS.

### 🚧 Known limitations

- 🔄 **Upgrading from 0.5.0:** The old shared database is not migrated or automatically removed. Reindexing restores server-derived indexes, but not old Downloads history, Photos receipts or cached place results.
- 🚧 **Demo destinations:** Search and Library collections still show demo data. Albums are read-only; creation, editing and membership changes are not included.
- 💾 **Offline media:** Album indexing saves metadata. Originals and video playback still depend on existing caches, saved Photos resources or a reachable server.
- 📤 **Sharing scope:** Share one asset at a time; shared files retain available GPS metadata.
- 📸 **Live Photo sharing:** Shares the displayed still; Save to Photos preserves the Live Photo pair.
- 🔄 **Download recovery:** Partial-data reuse still depends on iOS and server support; a download may restart when resuming is unavailable.

### 📦 Installation

- 📱 **Requirements:** iOS/iPadOS 26.6 or later. Connect to your own Immich server, or use Remmich’s built-in demo sign-in to try it with the official Immich demo server.
- 📦 **IPA installation:** Sign the optimized unsigned IPA with your own Apple ID through AltStore Classic or another compatible sideloading tool.
First release: native timelines and media viewing, previews, Photon places and maps, offline browsing, sharing, and Save to Photos with background downloads and Pause/Resume.
